overrides.replacement_plain_language: The policy answer is exactly allow or deny.
overrides.boundary: A reason, transport error, audit event, exception, or third value is outside this accepted decision value.

overrides.replacement_formal: forall q. (Decision(q)=ALLOW <-> exists s,t,v. AuthorizationAdmissible(q,s,t,v) and ExactActiveRoleGrant(q,s)) and (Decision(q)=DENY <-> not exists s,t,v. AuthorizationAdmissible(q,s,t,v) and ExactActiveRoleGrant(q,s))
overrides.replacement_plain_language: Allow only an admissible request with an exact grant from a role active in its resolved session; deny every other in-scope request.
overrides.boundary: This rule does not infer active roles from user assignment and does not prove resolver completeness, trusted scope production, runtime conformance, or system security.

overrides.replacement_formal: ExactActiveRoleGrant(q,s) <-> exists r,p. ResolvedActiveRole(s,r) and Grants(r,p) and PermissionExactEqual(p,RequiredPermission(q))
overrides.replacement_plain_language: A session authorizes only through a role that is active in that session and grants the exact permission required by the request.
overrides.boundary: AssignedRole does not imply ResolvedActiveRole; wildcard, hierarchy, direct user permission, explicit deny, and role inheritance are excluded.

overrides.replacement_plain_language: A role assigned to a user is not automatically active in every session.
overrides.boundary: Role-assignment consistency is a broader model concern, not a premise added to the bounded authorization FormalClaim.

overrides.replacement_plain_language: The business meaning is accepted and the v4 claim is drafted, but no claim admission, obligation, provider execution, or evidence result exists.
overrides.boundary: Do not describe the current candidate as proof, runtime conformance, security, resilience, release, or production readiness.
